requirements.text: The baseline linkage closes (assembles) at every drive angle from 0 to 92 deg.
requirements.source: Implicit precondition of the paper's four-bar deployment claim.
requirements.quantity: baseline assemblable over the drive range
assumptions: Planar pin-jointed loop; lengths are pin-centre distances.

requirements.text: The transmission angle stays within 40-140 deg throughout deployment.
requirements.source: Common linkage design guidance cited by the historical C1 note and tests.
assumptions: The angle is only defined for poses where the loop closes.

requirements.text: The over-center toggle holds the fin at the deployed position against the design hinge moment.
requirements.source: Paper claim: over-center locking at a 92 deg toggle.
requirements.quantity: holding moment at the deployed position
assumptions: Requires a linkage that can be assembled (R-C1-CLOSURE).
requirements.note: Not modeled: the only over-center helper compares angles and ignores geometry.

requirements.text: Deploy-output timing jitter is below 1 ms relative to the trigger.
requirements.quantity: peak absolute deviation of output edge from requested delay
assumptions: Measured with an instrument independent of the ESP32 clock.

requirements.text: Scheduling the deployment does not block the control loop.
assumptions: esp_timer callbacks run in the timer task and trigger_deployment_sequence returns immediately.

requirements.text: Generated NACA 00xx coordinates scale to the chord and are symmetric about the chord line.
The generator exports readable STEP solids with collision-free file names.
requirements.source: C3 claim: STEP export for downstream CAD/CFD.

requirements.text: Candidate materials reduce total mass by 30-40% relative to the baseline.
assumptions: The four listed parts are the relevant assembly.

requirements.text: The mass rollup's parts, volumes, and baseline materials describe the assembly being claimed.
requirements.source: Needed for any mass claim to refer to a real design.

requirements.text: Static margin stays between 1.5 and 2.0 calibers through the motor burn.
assumptions: Barrowman static margin is the intended metric.
The CG history uses the hard-coded Estes C6-5, not the OpenRocket file's G64W.

requirements.text: The static-margin formulation and its inputs are appropriate for this geometry and motor.
requirements.source: Needed before any static-margin result can be relied on.

requirements.text: The supplied spring rate is at least the calculated minimum.
requirements.source: Paper claim: k >= 185 N*m/rad with k_supplied = 220 N*m/rad.

requirements.text: The supplied spring rate exceeds the calculated minimum by at least 20%.
The supplied spring's measured rate is 220 N*m/rad within its stated tolerance.
Simulated deployment succeeds in at least 99.9% of trials.
requirements.source: Paper claim: at least 99.9% reliability from Monte Carlo.
assumptions: The simulation's success criterion can fail; see D-013, which says it cannot for its velocity test.

requirements.text: Repeated inert deployments of a physical mechanism lock at the deployed position.
requirements.source: Needed before any reliability statement about hardware.

requirements.text: The laminate's in-plane modulus matches or exceeds 6061-T6 aluminium (69 GPa).
requirements.source: Paper claim: match or exceed aluminium stiffness.
assumptions: The comparison is on material modulus, as in the historical note.

requirements.text: At equal or lower mass, the CFRP fin section is at least as stiff in bending as the aluminium section it replaces.
requirements.source: The thickness-compensation argument in the historical note.
assumptions: Requires section geometry for both designs; none is recorded.

requirements.text: The hinge pin's factor of safety exceeds 1.5 under the 50 g deployment load.
requirements.source: Paper claim: F.S. > 1.5 under 50 g shock.
assumptions: Double shear with central point-load bending; 154 g fin.
